records.FullPageBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} can give you a different way to respond to something that usually touches an old sore spot. Chiron does not require the history to disappear; the new beginning is in noticing that the present situation may give you more options than the old one did.

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Full Moon across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can show you exactly where an old sensitivity has been shaping a current decision. Chiron brings the tender spot into view; the Full Moon helps separate what is happening now from the conclusion you learned to expect before.

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can push a new response into a place where the old reflex still feels safer. Chiron may make the risk feel personal, while the eclipse makes the moment feel urgent. You do not have to repeat the old reaction just because the feeling is familiar.

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Lunar Eclipse across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can bring an old pattern to a point where its cost is easier to see than its protection. Chiron can make the hurt feel immediate, but the eclipse also shows what the reflex has been making you carry long after the original situation ended.
